profile_text.body:
Teradata Corp /DE/ describes itself on its site as “the AI platform for the autonomous era, connecting and scaling across any environment.” It says AI is reshaping how business runs and that its Autonomous Knowledge Platform makes it “real, trusted, governed, and built to scale.” The company also says its product and service portfolio empowers organizations to harness AI, analytics, and cloud solutions for accelerated innovation and sustainable growth, and that it partners with leading providers to deliver technology, AI-driven resources, and knowledge.

The company’s profile lists it as a public company (ticker TDC, CIK 0000816761) headquartered in San Diego, CA, with website https://www.teradata.com. It is a for-profit organization. A California law exposure count of 281 is associated with the company.
